title: I took a ride in an Nvidia-powered autonomous Mercedes at GTC 2026 - and it’s convinced me this is the future | TechRadar
summary: Nvidia demonstrated its Hyperion platform for autonomous vehicles at the GTC 2026 event, showcasing level 2 autonomous driving technology in a Mercedes CLA. The car successfully navigated various road conditions and interacted safely with its surroundings, including avoiding collisions and anticipating turns.
sentiment_reason: The article highlights successful autonomous driving features and safety measures, indicating a positive market impact with potential for growth in the autonomous vehicle industry.
